name: Kunimi Yutaka
source:
The successor of the Kunimi Shrine, he is made to attend Shinto-studies class at university. He is against succeeding the shrine, but he himself doesn't know what else he should do, which results in him spending his days in anguish. All of that recoiled on him and he took a deep interest in PCs and mobile phones. He just acquired the newest model of a smartphone and is all over it.

Drawn in by the situation, he goes with the flow and makes babies with the goddesses. As a result, he ends up having to take responsibility and regrets what he did, but eventually he adapts to the situation and starts enjoying his life together with the goddesses.
